title: Component: Zellij
requirement: Zellij must be installed and used, not replaced.

blueprint_contracts: Yazelix remains the Nix-owned Zellij runtime.
yzx enter replaces the launcher process with the pinned Zellij runtime and forwards Zellij arguments.
LifeOS embeds this runtime through a real PTY and does not reimplement it.

conclusion: Zellij 0.44.3 is installed and directly verified. An active Yazelix-managed Zellij client is running with its pinned config and layout, demonstrating use rather than substitution.
